facts.fact: Safflower got the highest absolute MSP increase for RMS 2027-28: Rs 675 per quintal
facts.quote: The absolute highest increase in MSP has been announced for Safflower at Rs.675 per quintal followed by Rapeseed & Mustard at Rs.413 per quintal.

facts.fact: Safflower MSP for RMS 2027-28 is Rs 7,215 per quintal
Rapeseed & Mustard had the next highest increase, Rs 413 per quintal

facts.quote: Cabinet approves Minimum Support Prices (MSP) for Rabi Crops for Marketing Season 2027-28 Posted On: 30 SEP 2026 3:06PM by PIB Delhi

summary: PIB 30 Sep 2026 CCEA release confirms safflower +Rs 675 to Rs 7,215 and rapeseed & mustard +Rs 413 to Rs 6,613 for RMS 2027-28.
